intro: Egypt has over 110 million people, the most in the Arab world, and its population is growing fast.

chapters.title: People and faith
text: Arabic is the language, with a distinctive Egyptian dialect understood across the Arab world thanks to its films and TV. Most people are Sunni Muslim; Coptic Christians are about a tenth.
Greater Cairo is one of the largest cities in the world, with over 20 million people.

chapters.title: A new capital
text: Egypt is building a New Administrative Capital in the desert east of Cairo to ease crowding.

keyTerms.meaning: Egypt's Christian community, one of the oldest in the world.
